collectible:1.text: Tags are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. There are 100 Tags located all around Los Santos, which the player must find and paint a Grove Street Families tag over it using a Spray Can while on foot. A tag needs at least 29 units of Spray Can "ammo" to be completely sprayed over.

collectible:2.text: Snapshots are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. There are 50 Snapshots located all around San Fierro and city limits, which the player must find and photograph using a Camera. The Camera has several spawn points in San Fierro, all located near Snapshot locations.

collectible:3.text: Horseshoes are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. There are 50 Horseshoes located all around Las Venturas, which the player must find and collect while on foot. Each Horseshoe collected rewards the player with $100 and 20 points of "Luck" in the Stats menu (which does not affect the gameplay in any way), totaling $5,000 and 1000 "Luck" points for collecting all Horseshoes.

collectible:4.text: Oysters are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. There are 50 Oysters located all around San Andreas, which the player must find and collect while swimming. Each Oyster collected rewards the player with $100, totaling $5,000 for collecting all Oysters alone. Collecting all 50 Oysters is a requirement for the 100% completion.

collectible:5.text: Unique Stunt Jumps (also known as Unique Jumps in 3D Universe and Stunt Jumps in GTA IV) are a feature in every Grand Theft Auto game since GTA III (with the exception of GTA Advance). All GTA games have jumps set up around their maps for "insane" stunting.
